ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 macro-level ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Distinct contiguous high-intensity white region localized on the distal third of the left lobe; fragmented, mottled high-intensity white region on the distal third of the right lobe; central region and proximal edges are predominantly low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 75 degrees and a bounding-box depth of roughly 15% of the total vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the continuous linear boundary of the trailing edge, featuring peaks and valleys ranging from 3 to 12 pixels in depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature fitted to the outer trailing edges of both lobes, transitioning into a concave curve toward the central median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-intensity white pixel clusters (5-15 pixel diameter) localized on the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple thin, low-contrast linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the black-pigmented areas on the right lobe and lower-center fluke regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized clusters of high-contrast calcified organisms on the distal tips and parallel linear rake mark scarring visible across the dark-pigmented ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant asymmetry in pigmentation patterns between the solid white distal patch on the left lobe and the mottled/speckled white pattern on the right lobe.
